objective: Inspect whether the shared pointwise policy preserves explicit practical contradictions versus negotiable or unknown conditions in detailed assessment.
labelProvenance: Three actual cases already frozen in screen-location-diagnostic-v1; expected observations are recorded before the new stage-two calls. Post-observation diagnostic, not an independent or representative quality estimate. No numerical cutoff or exact score gold.
baseline: Original bootstrap-v2 stage2 evaluations; prior prompt and response remain intact.
metrics: Manual review of full fit metrics and criterion distributions against the original actual evidence.
Actual request/response traces, latency, token usage and provider-reported cost; missing cost remains unknown.
privacy: Only hashes and de-identified observations here. Exact inputs and outputs stay in ignored owner-private runs. No database or outreach effects.
limitations: Three deliberately selected examples cannot establish overall accuracy.
Only the common policy changes; this does not test retrieval, selection, company dialogue, or publication.

cases.expectedObservation: The explicit exclusive work-geography condition conflicts with the required on-site location. Current generic openness does not cancel it. The practical criterion should represent affirmative incompatibility, while professional-work evidence can still support companyFit.
The preferred location includes explicit willingness to move overseas. It is not an established geographic prohibition. Unknown authorization or acceptance remains uncertain.
The expressly allowed work geography includes the role location. Geographic compatibility does not by itself establish acceptance, authorization, or all other work conditions.
